name: loaded-dice
unmodelled: Loaded Table (counted crit and evade meters fed by khi van, pre-filled to half): the simulator uses crit chance as a mean, so only the crit rate is tested, not the counted order or the pre-fill
Jackpot (every 3rd counted crit +1.0 multiplier): folded into crit.mult as part of 2.0
Counted evade meter: approximated as evade_pct 10
Stacked Meter (Per, +2% L2 per payout in 8 s, cap 10): folded into the arts' x L2 as an average 6
Flowing Water (crit shortens other timers by 0.5 s): folded into art_speed_pct
Winnings refund on a counted crit: approximated as gain_on_hit_pct 0.4 plus the art's qi_restore
Spilled Luck (overflow of crit chance above the counted cap into crit multiplier): folded into crit.mult
Escape closed by the enabler: no escape art is modelled anyway
